reviewer: Separate Claude review agent, independent of the collector and extractor; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of the somatic small-variant oncogenicity batch for use-case-somatic-small-variant-oncogenicity: 1,191 records after removing two duplicates of main records (794 results, 247 evaluations, 82 configurations, 43 methods, 8 sources, 7 protocols, 7 relevance judgements, 3 datasets). All eight source artifacts match their pinned SHA-256 (the bioRxiv page through its archived copy; a fresh download differs only in per-request CDN tokens). All 794 results were re-read from the pinned cells with a separate parser and match in value, printed form, metric, unit, direction, locator, configuration and protocol. Descriptive corrections and relevance changes, none of which changes a value, are listed in docs/reviews/use-cases/somatic-small-variant-oncogenicity-2026-10-09.md.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any predictor.
The OncoCal table was not regenerated: its inputs (dbNSFP 5.3.1a, COSMIC v104) are licensed and not redistributed. The generating code was read at the pinned commit, not run.
Chen et al. 2020 figures, benchmarks 1, 3 and 4 and the AUC values were not checked; the bioRxiv PDF and S1 to S8 Tables were not retrieved.
CTAT authorship overlap with Chen et al. could not be checked from the pinned sources.
Relevance judgements are reviewed but not pinned; the lead records pins with npm run use-cases:repin after the use-case change.
The SHACL step of records add and npm run build were not run; a dry-run addBatch against a scratch copy of the store accepted all 1,191 records.

findings.message: Mean plus or minus two standard deviations stored as confidence_interval; structured uncertainty removed, missing_metadata.uncertainty with a note added, printed range kept in printed_source_cell.
Two Chen et al. authors co-developed CanDrA (reference 7); origin changed to author_reported.

record_ids: 250 OncoKB results, 2 protocols, 50 evaluations, 1 dataset, 2 judgements
findings.message: Qualifier asserted the oncogenic-only positive set, which Additional files 9 and 10 do not state.
AUPRC column is scikit-learn average precision (metric average-precision); AUROC and average precision unit unitless, as for every AUROC in the store; metric_implementation filled from the code.
Method types checked against Chen Table 1 and OncoCal reclassify_tools.py.
relevance direct changed to proxy: the threshold is each tool's median on the test draw.
Replaced with the reviewed block from the RNA pathogen branch (exactMatch STATO_0000619), byte for byte.

Two batch records duplicated main records; removed, and the three configurations now link configuration_of to uc-clinical-20260930-method-bayesdel and uc20260930-model-esm-1b. The main MVP record is a different tool and was not used.
